title: 第25章 鲲鹏观想法第26章 阴蛇缠
content_zh:
“先榨点果汁，补充一下体能。”
在武馆练了几个小时，自助餐吃的那一肚子肉早消化完了，本来他打算在外面吃过宵夜再回来的，但无奈钱包余额不允许他这么豪气。
反正这点体能消耗，他调几杯活力果汁就能补充，也就没必要浪费钱了。
“好像感觉更加灵敏了，这次是腐臭橙汁……果然，我现在已经可以提前预感到接下来的变异方向，这些能量的转化融合其实是有过程的，以前精神力低无法感应，现在却可以触摸到一点门路了。”
服用了绿芽朝露全面修复身体之后，整体属性大幅度提升，他现在已经相当于武者二段的实力，精神力更是他的最强项，许多以前无法感应到的细微变化，现在都一一呈现在他的心中。
他的手法也随之更进一步，更加迅速流畅，一两分钟就完成了一次调配过程。
“可惜这个变异是随机性的，没办法引导它往正面变化。”
连续两次出了恶臭果汁，第三次之后，终于是元气满满的活力橙汁。
“如果有钱，可以试一下泡些人参茶，枸杞茶，那应该更有几率出大补的属性，对修炼肯定更有帮助，毕竟现在变异的野兽血肉太难获得了。”没有进补的资源，修炼进度会很慢，方南山必须要想办法解决这个问题。
须尽快从仙界里提取些有价值的东西出来换钱，否则现实里修炼进度要跟不上了。
“小猫咪，你也想喝果汁？”
感受着快要掏空的身体又渐渐充满了活力，方南山正要停下，换成茶壶，忽然发现搁在一个纸箱盒子里的受伤小猫咪，不知什么时候半趴在盒子边缘，目光炯炯的看着他，并且随着他手中的玻璃杯一上一下，似乎有点渴望。
“喵呜！”
它虚弱的叫了一声。
方南山想了下，好像猫咪不可以喝橙汁和茶的，但变异的不知行不行，先让它试一点点，如果有不良反应，再换其它适合的饮料。
于是拿了个小碟子，倒了一点活力橙汁下去，小猫咪马上凑过来，伸出舌头舔了几下，碟子迅速就干净了。
然后抬起头，看向方南山手中的杯子，轻轻的叫了一声。
“你还想要是吗？”伸手撸了一下小猫咪柔顺的毛发，再倒一点果汁下去，这些橙汁经过变异之后，确实没多少原来的味道了，变异能量占据绝大部分，它有增加活力，加快伤口愈合的功效，对现在的小猫来说，很适合。
“还没给你起名字，以后，你就叫小花吧。”
方南山脑子里闪过一连串的名字，但最后还是选择最简单最直接最普通的那个。

这花纹猫，本身也只是普通的流浪猫生下的幼崽。
喝了小半杯果汁，小花就满足了，回到盒子里继续团成团，半眯着眼歇息。
方南山继续专注的泡茶，希望能再出【绿芽朝露】这样的极品。
可惜直到十二点，也没能再出一次，这种极品的衍生概率非常低，今天他也算是走了大运，才出来一次，想要连续出，那根本不可能。
content_en:
"Squeeze some juice first to replenish your physical energy."
After practicing in the martial arts hall for several hours, he had already finished digesting the meat he had eaten at the buffet. He originally planned to have a late-night snack outside before coming back, but his wallet balance did not allow him to be so bold.
Anyway, he could replenish this physical energy consumption by mixing a few glasses of energy juice, so there was no need to waste money.
"It seems that my senses are more sensitive. This time it's rancid orange juice... Sure enough, I can already predict the direction of the next mutation in advance. The transformation and fusion of these energies actually have a process. I used to have low mental power and could not sense it, but now I can touch a little bit."
After taking Green Bud Morning Dew to fully repair his body, his overall attributes have been greatly improved. He is now equivalent to the strength of a second-level warrior, and his mental strength is his strongest point. Many subtle changes that he could not sense before are now present in his heart one by one.
His technique also went a step further, becoming faster and smoother, and he completed the blending process in a minute or two.
"It's a pity that this mutation is random, and there is no way to guide it to change positively."
I had stinky juice twice in a row, but after the third time, I finally got the energetic orange juice that was full of energy.
"If you have money, you can try brewing some ginseng tea or wolfberry tea. That should have a higher chance of producing great tonic properties, which will definitely be more helpful to practice. After all, mutated beast flesh and blood is too difficult to obtain now." Without the tonic resources, the progress of cultivation will be very slow, and Fang Nanshan must find a way to solve this problem.
You must extract some valuable things from the fairy world as soon as possible and exchange them for money, otherwise your cultivation progress in reality will not be able to keep up.
"Kitten, do you want to drink juice too?"
Feeling that his nearly empty body was gradually filled with vitality, Fang Nanshan was about to stop and change to a teapot when he suddenly found an injured kitten in a cardboard box, half-lying on the edge of the box at some point, looking at him with bright eyes, and seemed to be a little eager as the glass in his hand moved up and down.
"Meow!"
It gave a weak cry.
Fang Nanshan thought for a while and realized that cats shouldn't drink orange juice and tea, but he didn't know if it would work due to the mutation. Let him try a little bit first. If there are any adverse reactions, he would switch to other suitable drinks.
So I took a small plate and poured some orange juice into it. The kitten immediately came over and stuck out its tongue to lick it a few times. The plate was quickly clean.
Then he raised his head, looked at the cup in Fang Nanshan's hand, and called out softly.
"Do you still want it?" He reached out and brushed the kitten's soft hair, and then poured some juice down. After the orange juice was mutated, it really didn't have much of the original taste. The mutated energy took up most of it. It has the effect of increasing vitality and accelerating wound healing. It is very suitable for today's kittens.
"I haven't given you a name yet. From now on, you can call me Xiaohua."
A series of names flashed through Fang Nanshan's mind, but in the end he chose the simplest, most direct and common one.
This tabby cat itself is just a cub born by an ordinary stray cat.
After drinking less than half a cup of juice, Xiaohua was satisfied. She returned to the box and continued to make balls, resting with half-closed eyes.
Fang Nanshan continued to concentrate on brewing tea, hoping to produce a top quality tea like [Green Bud Morning Dew] again.
It's a pity that he couldn't come out again until twelve o'clock. The probability of deriving this kind of top quality is very low. Today he was lucky enough to come out only once. It's impossible to come out continuously.
